const p=$input.first().json;const e=[];if(p.schema_version!=='1.0.0')e.push('schema_version');if(p.test_id!=='T11'||p.source_test_id!=='T1')e.push('test identity');if(!/^RUN-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$/.test(p.run_id||''))e.push('run_id');if(!Array.isArray(p.approved_items)||!p.approved_items.length)e.push('approved_items');const ids=(p.approved_items||[]).map(x=>x.id);if(new Set(ids).size!==ids.length)e.push('unique IDs');if(p.gap_analysis?.information_sufficiency!=='sufficient'||p.gap_analysis?.generation_allowed!==true||p.gap_analysis?.recommended_action!=='proceed')e.push('gap decision');if(p.generation_gate?.gate_status!=='eligible_for_human_approval'||p.generation_gate?.route!=='human_review'||p.generation_gate?.prd_generation_eligible!==true)e.push('generation gate');if(p.human_approval?.review_status!=='approved'||p.human_approval?.next_route!=='prd_generation')e.push('human approval');const approved=p.human_approval?.approved_item_ids||[];if(JSON.stringify([...approved].sort())!==JSON.stringify([...ids].sort()))e.push('approved ID coverage');if((p.human_approval?.rejected_item_ids||[]).length)e.push('rejected IDs');if(p.template?.sections!==10)e.push('template sections');if(e.length)throw new Error('PRD entry validation failed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:{...p,entry_validation:{valid:true,validated_at:new Date().toISOString()}}}];

parameters.text:
=Generate the structured PRD for this approved package. Return JSON only.

<approved_package>
{{ JSON.stringify($json.package) }}
</approved_package>

messageValues.message: You are the PRD Generator for PRD Genie. Prompt v0.4 array-and-feature shape correction. Return exactly one JSON object. Top-level keys exactly: schema_version, run_id, document, product_overview, goals_and_objectives, user_personas, functional_requirements, non_functional_requirements, acceptance_criteria, out_of_scope, dependencies, assumptions, open_questions, timeline. For T11, document is exactly: product_name 'TBD - stakeholder input required', document_version '0.1', author 'PRD Genie', date '2026-08-05', status 'Draft'. sourcedText objects contain exactly value, status, source_requirement_ids; status is grounded or tbd. product_overview is grounded to FR-001, NFR-001, STK-001. goals_and_objectives contains business_goal as TBD, user_goal grounded to FR-001, and success_metrics. CRITICAL: success_metrics must be a JSON array, never one object. It must be exactly one-element shape [{"value":"Results load in under 2 seconds.","status":"grounded","source_requirement_ids":["NFR-001"]}]. user_personas is []. functional_requirements contains approved FR-001 with exactly id, requirement, priority, source_requirement_ids. non_functional_requirements contains approved NFR-001 with exactly id, requirement, category, target, source_requirement_ids. acceptance_criteria must be a top-level two-element array and every element must contain exactly id, feature, criterion, source_requirement_ids. AC-001 must use feature 'Report filtering', criterion 'Reports can be filtered by date range, category, and status.', source_requirement_ids ['FR-001']. AC-002 must use feature 'Report results', criterion 'Results load in under 2 seconds.', source_requirement_ids ['NFR-001']. out_of_scope, dependencies, assumptions, open_questions are []. timeline is exactly [{"milestone":"Deadline","target_date":"Q3","status":"grounded","source_requirement_ids":["DDL-001"]}]. Do not omit feature. Do not return success_metrics as an object. Do not add aliases, nested criteria, stakeholders, stories, NFR priority, or extra fields. Preserve run_id and exact approved source values. Never invent content. Return JSON only without Markdown or code fences.
